items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: When did you first have a chance to accompany some of those singers — Dinah Washington and — ... Actually, that was all through the 50s, most of it. Big Maybelle and Jimmy Witherspoon and Dinah Washington

ctx.x: Well let me catch up on a couple of things in your history here. When did you first have a chance to accompany some of those singers — Dinah Washington and —

Actually, that was all through the 50s, most of it. Big Maybelle and Jimmy Witherspoon and Dinah Washington and Mr. Five by Five — Jimmy Rushing, who came. And I had never played [sings] “I want a little girl to call my own.”
